title: Short descriptive title of task or research question
public_summary: One-line public intake summary (no secrets or sensitive details)
inputs: Explicit input datasets, parameters, or specs with units and timezones
constraints: Hard limits, latency/cost bounds, no lookahead leakage
assumptions: Explicit provisional assumptions that must be challenged
unknowns: List unresolved questions here; set block_on_unresolved_unknowns=true until answered

hypothesis.economic_rationale: Structural market mechanism explaining why the effect exists and who is on the other side
alternative_explanations: Alternative non-alpha explanation (e.g., bid-ask bounce, volatility clustering, leakage)
falsification_criteria: Specific statistical or empirical result that rejects this hypothesis

cost_model_assumptions: Explicit spread, commission, funding, and slippage assumptions
quant_checks.multiple_testing_plan: Track all tested configurations and adjust significance (e.g., DSR / FDR)
quant_checks.oos_validation_plan: Define exact unseen out-of-sample period and walk-forward protocol

authority.objective: Clear bounded objective authorized by Owner
